newsitem.title: USA: Eight striking UPS workers arrested.
newsitem.headline: Eight striking UPS workers arrested.

text.p: Two striking UPS workers were arrested Monday and charged with disorderly conduct at the company's facility on the south side of Chicago, police said.
In Massachusetts, police reported arresting six UPS strikers at two Boston area facilties also for disorderly conduct.
The Chicago area workers were allegedly blocking early morning truck traffic into and out of the facility, a central terminal for UPS.
Pickets went up across the country around midnight after talks between the Teamsters union representing about 190,000 workers and the nation's largest private shipper broke down.
The Teamsters want more fulltime jobs, better wages and pensions.
UPS said the strike was endangering the livelihood of 385,000 employees. No new talks had been scheduled.
